emb_unique_rows_off.note: Lane gap-neural-io (plan gaps-2026-10-08 Section 4). Default ON (IDENTICAL, not under sabotage arms): the embedding binding's backward compacts the touched rows from run_begin (3 integer launches), reads U back (one wait) and folds U*d cells instead of V*d (T >= V) or T*d (T < V) when U < min(T, V). Same per-cell fold statements: no bit moves on any column; training loops keep their launch (opt-in parameter). The OFF arm is the old launch rule. Unmeasured: A/B owed on the embedding cell plus a neighboring shape (e.g. V=50,257, T=65,536) and one skewed-id batch.
